title: 2024 Panini Mosaic Silver Prizm Kyle Hamilton Baltimore Ravens Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Panini Mosaic sports trading card featuring Kyle Hamilton from the Baltimore Ravens. It is a Silver Prizm parallel variety card from the base set. This card does not have an autograph and is manufactured by Panini. It is part of the National Football League (NFL) collection.
